script.speaker: brooke
script.text: small table tonight: just the four of us by the water. where are we eating?

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: A confession first. On Sunday I bought a bamboo mat, a bag of short-grain rice and a stack of seaweed sheets.

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Eleven attempts. Every one unrolled itself on the way to the plate. Tonight I would like to eat some rolled by a professional.

script.speaker: maya
script.text: cyrus. you followed the instructions and LOST? photos. now.

script.speaker: mina
script.text: i was there for attempt seven :) it tasted lovely, it just came apart in the soy dish. i think he was very brave

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: eleven is dedication. i'd have ordered in after two

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Mina, attempt seven was yours, so no fish in it. Tonight I'd like the sushi day standard for you: a whole part of the menu with no fish and no meat, not one token roll.

script.speaker: maya
script.text: eleven rolls fall apart and he's still planning everyone's dinner. never change, cyrus

script.speaker: mina
script.text: maya, i'm the only one here who missed your big news. i want all of it tonight, somewhere calm and hushed so you only have to tell it once

script.speaker: maya
script.text: mina!! short version: my plan got picked, i got promoted, and i cried a little in the supply closet. long version tonight

script.speaker: maya
script.text: but promoted, not loaded. two dollar signs is my number now. one sign over and i'll still come, i'll just order the cheapest thing and eat it very slowly and very sadly

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: the supply closet part is new. i need that version

script.speaker: mina
script.text: cyrus, while maya tells it, i'll be reading the sauces for you. the satay incident happens exactly once: no peanut anywhere, not even in a dressing

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: and i've got the harbour fun run at eight tomorrow. tonight i want light, clean food, nothing that's been through a fryer

script.speaker: maya
script.text: a fun run. at eight. on purpose. brooke, blink twice if you need help

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Assistant, I've done enough rolling for one week. Your turn.
